name: Roth.wronskianMatrix
source:
noncomputable def wronskianMatrix (φ : Fin l → K[X]) : Matrix (Fin l) (Fin l) K[X] :=
  Matrix.of fun μ ν ↦ hasseDeriv μ (φ ν)

what: Defines the square matrix whose rows are successive univariate Hasse derivatives of a finite polynomial family.
how: Matrix.of bundles the function sending row and column indices to Polynomial.hasseDeriv of that column polynomial at the row order.
